Home / Transparency

The public record, in sections.

This guide separates what the town publishes from what could not be verified. Procurement and project notices have official pages; budgets, audit reports, and DILG filings do not have checked local sources here.

A missing record is shown as a gap, never as a zero value or a copied figure from another town.

How to read this section

Every entry on this site is linked to a municipal or government-hosted page. If a fact is not linked, it should not be treated as verified. Where two official pages disagree, the disagreement is recorded on the sources page.

The vocabulary is deliberately narrow: Verified means checked against the linked page; Reported means the source states it but it is not independently confirmed; Unverified means the fact is not published here. The source note on each page states the checked date separately from the data's own as-of date.
